lines.text: This homework is all Greek to me.

data.define: Used when something is too confusing to understand.

example.text: This homework is all Greek to me.

misuse.text: Don't say 'it's all Greek to me' about easy tasks.

publish.title: What does "it's all Greek to me" mean?
publish.value: It's all Greek to me = I understand nothing. Example: "This homework is all Greek to me." (casual English).
